_about: Recovered names for the reference binary, applied by tools/recomp/corpus.py when it renders a
decompilation. A name here is a claim as strong as a // ref: tag: it says what the function or
global IS, not what it resembles. Linked frozen names come from data/map.json automatically and
do not need to be repeated here; add a function only when it is not linked yet or the frozen
name is wrong. Keys are 8-digit lower-case hex reference addresses.
functions: addr -> name.  globals: addr -> {name, type, note}.
classes: class -> {"0xNN": {name, type, note}}.  this: addr -> class (which class a function's
this/param_1 is, so its field accesses render as this->name).
